create_function_transformer: create a FunctionTransformer from an arbitrary callable like np.log1p for stateless transformations
build_function_transformer_with_inverse: build a FunctionTransformer with both func and inverse_func for reversible transformations
test_function_transformer_transform: test the FunctionTransformer transform method to apply a user-defined function to input data
refactor_function_transformer_validate: refactor the FunctionTransformer to validate input arrays before passing them to the transformation function
review_function_transformer_feature_name: review the FunctionTransformer get_feature_names_out method to determine output feature names
